summary: iter_206 Phase C — Backend GREEN (3/3). Mobile Home GREEN. Mobile pay-checkout receipt flow BROKEN — critical field-name mismatch between backend contract and mobile UI causes 'AED NaN' and prevents the full-points demo from completing. Deprecated expo-notifications web warning present (minor, not deprecated per Expo Related Pointers list).

ui_bugs.issue: Shows 'AED NaN' for 'You pay' and 'Pay AED NaN' button; BigCoin pills section hidden because maxPoints computes to 0.

integration_issues.issue: Mobile pay-checkout reads WRONG backend field names. Resolve returns {amount_cents, user_points_balance, settings:{...}} but UI reads resolved.subtotal_cents / resolved.user_balance / resolved.max_points_allowed / resolved.items (all undefined). Quote returns {subtotal_cents, total_cents, points_value_cents, card_cents, points_to_use, points_earned} but UI reads quote.charge_cents / quote.points_discount_cents (undefined → NaN in formatCents). Because maxPoints = Math.min(undefined, undefined) = NaN, the BigCoin pill row never renders → the spec'd 'set BigCoin pills to max → pay AED 0.00 card' flow is impossible from mobile UI. Authorize is also sent with points_to_use=0 → 400 merchant_stripe_missing from backend (biz_demo_karak has no stripe_charges_enabled).

action_items: Fix /app/mobile/app/pay-checkout/[token].tsx field mapping to match backend contract: resolved.user_points_balance (not user_balance); resolved.amount_cents (not subtotal_cents); drop resolved.items (backend returns a single amount, no line items) OR synthesize one row from amount_cents; compute maxPoints client-side as Math.floor(amount_cents * settings.max_points_redemption_pct / 100) capped by user_points_balance. For quote: use quote.card_cents (not charge_cents) and quote.points_value_cents (not points_discount_cents). The pay() function already sends correct keys (points_to_use, tip_cents, qr_token) — only the display/derivation is wrong.

After the field fix, 100%-points path should go: resolve → quote(points_to_use=amount_cents) → authorize (no payment_method required because card_cents=0) → capture → receipt renders with Subtotal=AED 5.00 / Total paid=AED 0.00 / 0 BigCoin earned (points-only bill correctly earns nothing).
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/social_v2.py:930 friends_nearby is cleanly implemented — merges scan_earn_events ('checked in') with captured scan_to_pay_transactions ('paid'), the latter outranks the former on same (user,merchant) key, 6h window. Returns {items:[]} for users with no friends or no followed businesses (verified for freeuser).

backend/services/scan_to_pay_service.py:265 correctly refuses zero-charge (card==0 && points==0). For 100%-points: authorize sets status='authorized' (no Stripe call because card_cents=0), capture awards 0 points_earned (card portion rule), writes ledger row with stripe_payment_intent_id='stq_local:<tx>'. Capture response includes all 5 receipt fields the mobile UI needs: subtotal_cents, tip_cents, points_used, charge_cents, bigcoin_earned.

mobile/app/(tabs)/home.tsx — Social Wall + Near-you-now implementations are solid: items wrapped in Animated.View with FadeInDown + LinearTransition, 25s silent setInterval poll on both /social/feed-v2 and /social/friends-nearby, no visible loader, falls back for_you when following is empty. testIDs home-feed-0..2 and home-nearby-0 all confirmed via Playwright. Nearby card shows storefront icon fallback when business_logo missing (correct).

mobile/app/pay-checkout/[token].tsx — field mismatches with backend contract (see integration_issues). This file has drifted from the scan_to_pay_service response shape; the backend is the source of truth per the capture() docstring.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend contract (verified green): resolve returns {token, amount_cents, expires_at, merchant{...}, settings{points_per_dollar, max_points_redemption_pct}, user_points_balance}. Quote returns {subtotal_cents, tip_cents, total_cents, points_to_use, points_value_cents, card_cents, points_earned, max_points_allowed, merchant, user_points_balance}. Capture returns {ok, transaction_id, status='captured', card_cents, points_redeemed, points_earned, subtotal_cents, tip_cents, points_used, charge_cents, bigcoin_earned}. Full-points path (card_cents=0) short-circuits Stripe entirely — safe to run against the restricted LIVE key. After main agent fixes the mobile pay-checkout field names, rerun /app/backend/tests/test_iter206_phase_c.py (regression) + the Playwright pay-checkout scenario (navigate /pay-checkout/<token>, pick max BigCoin pill, tap pay-submit-btn, assert pay-receipt-title + no 'NaN' in body).
rca of the issue: Mobile pay-checkout UI was written against an older/draft backend contract (user_balance, max_points_allowed, charge_cents, points_discount_cents, items[]). The actual scan_to_pay_service returns user_points_balance / amount_cents / card_cents / points_value_cents and no per-item breakdown. Because JS silently returns undefined for missing keys and (undefined/100).toFixed(2) → 'NaN', the UI renders 'AED NaN' instead of blocking with an error. Fix is purely field-renames in /app/mobile/app/pay-checkout/[token].tsx — no backend change needed.
